name: avaira.xyz
description: Runtime governance layer that makes AI agents auditable, accountable, and rated. Like a credit score for autonomous agents.

paragraphs: x402 lets agents pay. ERC-8004 lets agents be identified. Avaira makes them accountable in real time — a credit bureau, mathematical safety kernel, and pre-execution circuit breaker enforced before agents act rather than audited after the damage.

The site is not live yet — avaira.vercel.app currently returns Vercel's 404, because the project is no longer connected to this repository. The button above (or the deploy runbook) is the one step that fixes it; make verify-deploy then proves the URL is serving the app.
